Topographic constraints within most of the project area would appear to preclude most potential residential-type developments; remoteness from industrial areas and population centers also makes the area of limited value for residential purposes.
Two Federal airways pass within 5 miles of the project site, one located 5 miles southeast with a compass heading of NO50°E., and the other about 3 miles south, with a heading of NO86°E. There are 21 airports within 50 miles of the site, with 4 having regularly scheduled passenger service at Asheville, Anderson, Greenville-Downtown, and Greenville-Spartanburg. The nearest airport, at Asheville, is 35 miles to the northeast of the project. The remaining 17 airports are mainly public use or smaller civil airports. No military air bases, controlled zones, or parachute jumping areas are located within 50 miles of the project (Applicant's data).
A Southern Railroad line is located 25 miles south of the project, and a Carolina Railroad spur line some 20 miles south-southwest of the project (Applicant's data).
